AAHD: AAHD exceeds the robust limits across every pattern. The green-red and green-blue label pair is materially closer to LibRaw than the red-first and blue-first pair.
AHD: AHD is close to LibRaw on the green-red and green-blue labels and diverges strongly on the red-first and blue-first labels. The heavy tail is concentrated in discrete interpolation decisions rather than a global offset.
AMaZE: AMaZE exceeds the robust limits for every pattern, with the strongest divergence on the red-first and blue-first labels.
DCB: DCB exceeds the robust limits for every pattern. The green-red and green-blue labels are substantially closer than the opposite diagonal.
DHT: DHT exceeds the robust limits for every pattern and remains materially divergent even on its closest label pair.
Linear: Linear differs only because Fornax rounds to nearest while LibRaw truncates.
LMMSE: LMMSE fails its headline limits on every pattern. The red-first and blue-first labels also exceed the high-error fraction limit.
PPG: Fornax PPG is bit-identical to darktable PPG for every pattern. Against LibRaw it remains within the robust limits despite isolated outliers.
RCD: RCD remains within every robust limit. The green-red and green-blue labels are closest, while the opposite diagonal retains a small outlier tail.
VNG: Both VNG references show a broad failure rather than isolated outliers. The red-first and blue-first labels are the worse pair.
